entries.title: Find Help articles more easily
entries.summary: The Help Center now has topic navigation, a clearer reading layout, and section links within longer guides.

entries.title: A Help Center for Dana
entries.summary: Browse guides for tasks, planning, writing, and collaboration. Search and keyboard shortcuts are available without signing in.

entries.title: A personal bio for each teammate
entries.summary: Teammates now own their personal bio. Earlier project bios remain available as read-only context with attribution.

entries.title: More useful teammate profiles
entries.summary: Profiles separate project details from personal information, with space for relevant writing, images, and files.

entries.title: Easier date adjustments in Calendar
entries.summary: Task ranges have clearer resize handles. Drag either end to adjust dates, including on touch devices.

entries.title: Breadcrumbs show where you are
entries.summary: Location breadcrumbs now appear on root pages as well as nested pages, tasks, and other work surfaces.

entries.title: Task actions are easier to reach
entries.summary: Right-click a task in List, Board, Calendar, or Freeform to open its actions, including Open in new tab.

entries.title: Right-to-left text in Discussions
entries.summary: Arabic and other right-to-left text now reads in its natural direction within Discussion posts, including mixed-language writing.

entries.title: Reactions for Discussion posts
entries.summary: Respond to a Discussion post with one of six emoji reactions instead of only a like.

entries.title: Archive and restore work
entries.summary: Move finished work out of active views without deleting it. Restore archived pages from Settings when you need them again.

entries.title: Assign one task to several teammates
entries.summary: Add more than one assignee to a task and see everyone responsible across task lists and views.

entries.title: Nested pages in the Library sidebar
entries.summary: Find child pages beneath their parent pages in the Library, with expandable navigation and keyboard support.

entries.title: Calendar view for each Work page
entries.summary: See scheduled work by month, week, or day, and adjust task dates directly in Calendar.

entries.title: Board view for Work
entries.summary: Arrange tasks in Board columns by section, assignee, or date, without duplicating the underlying tasks.
